title: The Sunny's Push
flavor: You can see the counter in their hand. The ship can see it too.
teaches: Attacks win ties — but their Karoo counters for +1000, so a bare 5000 swing gets turned away. Rest the Thousand Sunny first: at 6000 your leader beats the counter on the tie. Vivi is not a Straw Hat, so the ship can only push the leader.
